headline: Saint-Gobain Q3 Growth Driven by Pricing Amid Volume Pressure
summary: Saint-Gobain reported third-quarter results showing that pricing power drove growth despite ongoing volume pressures.
why: Building materials manufacturers use pricing strategies to offset softer construction volumes in challenging macroeconomic environments.

impacts.name: Compagnie de Saint-Gobain SA
impacts.why: Ability to raise prices helps preserve revenue growth when underlying construction volumes contract.
